paper_metadata.title: Yield stress and stress anomaly in an Fe3Al alloy

evidence.quote: The mechanical properties of an Fe-28 at.% A1 alloy have been examined in detail from room temperature up to 700°C.

The variation in yield stress with test temperature has been examined for an alloy based on Fe-28at.OA A1 which has the DO, structure in equilibrium below about 590°C and the B2 structure above that temperature.
